items.title: 52240_Frank _Machito_ Grillo oral history interview
items.q: Took Andino with me and Ubaldo Nieto, the timbale player

ctx.x: Yes, as a matter of fact, we went to Havana because the the new thing was the ice show, because they had an ice show, so they going to change all the floor and everything. So the owner said: 'Machito, I am going to pay you your salary, but you could take off five or six or seven days. I send you a telegram when the floor will be raised because we got to change all the things, you know, all that refrigeration or whatever, so we went to Havana. Took Andino with me and Ubaldo Nieto, the timbale player and bass…
